# NEW 2026-11-23 v20.0 Definitive Edition — Module 20.0-A: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_def_kernel_yearly) (oe_def_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v200_native_definitive.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot O(1) yearly dispatcher exported for global kernel integration (global or country scope).
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_def_ran_y so it never double-fires.
# Spaces showcase dispatches to at most 1 event per year via global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y (clean on late bookmarks).
oe_def_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_start_is_1337 = yes
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_def_ran_y value = current_year }
		oe_def_dispatch_milestone_events = yes
	}
}

# Master milestone router: dispatches oe_def.1 .. oe_def.6 (one-shot each, max 1 per year, 0 orphans).
oe_def_dispatch_milestone_events = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y ?= current_year }
			current_year >= 1344
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_def_ev_1_done }
		}
		oe_def_route_heraldry_event = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y ?= current_year }
			current_year >= 1352
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_def_ev_2_done }
		}
		oe_def_route_celestial_banner_event = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y ?= current_year }
			current_year >= 1365
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_def_ev_3_done }
		}
		oe_def_route_destinies_event = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y ?= current_year }
			current_year >= 1390
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_def_ev_4_done }
		}
		oe_def_route_chancery_event = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y ?= current_year }
			current_year >= 1420
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_def_ev_5_done }
		}
		oe_def_route_protocol_event = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_def_last_ev_y ?= current_year }
			current_year >= 1445
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_def_ev_6_done }
		}
		oe_def_route_third_era_event = yes
	}
}

# 1. O(1) host router for oe_def.1 (Imperial Banner & Heraldry Reform, player-priority across showcase realms).
oe_def_route_heraldry_event = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:ROM = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:BYZ = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:FLO = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:TUS c:TUS = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:TUS = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:GLH c:GLH = { oe_def_is_flag_showcase_realm = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:GLH = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CHG c:CHG = { oe_def_is_flag_showcase_realm = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:CHG = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MOR c:MOR = { oe_def_is_flag_showcase_realm = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:MOR = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:TIB c:TIB = { oe_def_is_flag_showcase_realm = yes is_ai = no } }
		c:TIB = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes } }
		c:ROM = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes } }
		c:BYZ = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes } }
		c:FLO = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:TUS c:TUS = { oe_def_is_imperial_heraldry_host = yes } }
		c:TUS = { oe_def_fire_ev_1 = yes }
	}
}

oe_def_fire_ev_1 = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_def_ev_1_done value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_def_last_ev_y value = current_year }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_def.1
}

# 3. One-shot router for oe_def.3 (Golden Age of the 55 Destinies, player-priority then O(1) flagship fallback).
oe_def_route_destinies_event = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { is_ai = no oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = yes } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = yes }
			oe_def_fire_ev_3 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = yes } }
		c:ROM = { oe_def_fire_ev_3 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = yes } }
		c:BYZ = { oe_def_fire_ev_3 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = yes } }
		c:CHI = { oe_def_fire_ev_3 = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:FLO c:FLO = { oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = yes } }
		c:FLO = { oe_def_fire_ev_3 = yes }
	}
}

oe_def_fire_ev_3 = {
